title: Theory of Structured Anomie
text:
Anomie, in a sociological context, refers to a state of normlessness or a breakdown of the social rules that guide individual behavior. It suggests that when societal expectations are unclear or rapidly changing, individuals lack stable guidelines for living.

This theory posits that highly structured shifts—such as rapid economic booms followed by recessions, or sudden political upheaval—can weaken established moral frameworks. The result is a profound sense of disconnection and purposelessness within the collective.
